initialize_logging: initialize the root logger to a specific logging level such as logging.DEBUG or logging.INFO
replace_print_with_logging: replace the built-in print function with logging.info so all stdout prints go through the logging module
log_interval: decorate a function with log_interval to log entry and exit messages along with execution duration
log_interval_custom_category: decorate a function with log_interval using a custom category and name for structured logging context
log_enter_exit: use the internal _log_enter and _log_exit helpers to manually log entry and exit of a code block with duration
